question_mn: Хамгийн их орлого өгсөн ангилал (дээд түвшний)
question_latin: Hamgiin ih orlogo ugsun angilal (deed tvwshnii)
question_en: Top-level category with the highest revenue
gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(top.category_name, c.category_name) AS top_category, SUM(oi.line_total) AS revenue FROM t2s.order_items AS oi JOIN t2s.product_variants AS v ON v.variant_id = oi.variant_id JOIN t2s.products AS p ON p.product_id = v.product_id JOIN t2s.categories AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN t2s.categories AS top ON top.category_id = c.parent_category_id GROUP BY top_category ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

gold_sql_sqlite: SELECT COALESCE(top.category_name, c.category_name) AS top_category, SUM(oi.line_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN product_variants v ON v.variant_id = oi.variant_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN categories top ON top.category_id = c.parent_category_id GROUP BY top_category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
